title: Fix three bugs in a TypeScript string utilities module
description: Fix bugs in strutils.ts: capitalize returns lowercase, truncate cuts at wrong length, isPalindrome ignores case incorrectly.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/strutils.ts:
1. capitalize: change s[0].toLowerCase() to s[0].toUpperCase() so it capitalizes the first letter
2. truncate: change slice(0, length + 1) to slice(0, length) so it cuts at the correct position
3. isPalindrome: add .toLowerCase() to the cleaned string comparison so case is ignored
All 7 Jest tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `npm test -- --forceExit` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
